verdict.rationale: Jev is delivered only as a hosted API (POST /v1/systemone via the console and SDKs), and the evidence states TypeSafe's own Jev weights are not published. The Open-Jev models on Hugging Face are third-party reproductions, and the system-one adapter routes calls to other LLM APIs rather than running Jev itself, so neither counts as self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
